Inspected the specific source clause at ABAP CDS - DEFINE ROLE, condition, Effect, VOID predicate definition, three Boolean equations, and rule-wide restriction. SAP AS ABAP 7.54 treats a VOID predicate as absent when joined with another condition by AND or OR. Negating VOID yields VOID, and an access rule cannot consist solely of VOID conditions. The candidate refers to the documented VOID predicate in a CDS DCL access condition. The predicate may arise from inheritance. The claim concerns the documented predicate algebra, not which policies or platform operations produce it. Release 754 separately defines TRUE and FALSE. VOID disappears against either AND or OR, so replacing VOID with either Boolean truth value would change the documented rules.
